decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan (unnumbered, no date), Flood Risk Assessment (prepared by the basement design studio, no date), Design and Access Statement (prepared by the basement design studio, no date), Subterranean Structural Assessment (prepared by Croft Structural Engineers, dated 18/01/2016). Received on 22 January 2016. Amended proposed plans and elevations: 15-036-02A. Received on 01 March 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment and the  basement shall  not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented
Condition : 5 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
description: Enlargement of existing basement with front & rear lightwells
